**This is flow 2 — the saved item and correcting its details.** Please try these two things on a saved bookmark:

> 1. **Select the title** — it should open the original page in a new tab.
> 2. Press **"Edit details"** — the title and description turn into editable fields. Change the title (or type a note in the description), then press **Save changes** and see the item update.

What I set up here for you to check:

- A **favicon** sits to the left of each item. Note: in this prototype it's a **coloured letter tile** standing in for the real site icon, just so the layout is real — the finished app would show the actual site icon. Does having an icon there at that size feel right?
- The **address is now small and grey** beneath the title/description, so the title and description lead. Is that the balance you wanted?
- The description field doubles as where your **own notes** go. Is combining "description" and "my notes" into one place okay, or do you picture notes as a separate thing from the auto-description?

One thing I'm holding for our next step: showing **tags** on the item. Tags tie directly into finding links again, so I'd like to build saving-with-tags and the search next — but first, tell me how this item feels.
